fusions.name: Brine Downpour
fusions.desc: Lobs a heavy drop of brine that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles of it, leaving the target [Soaked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Drip
fusions.desc: Drips brine on an enemy up to 5 tiles away, dealing 9 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Sheltering Rainfall
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, 1% more for every 1% cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Quenched
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
